description: Send a callback request only after the customer explicitly agrees to send these contact details and this request to the named business; set consent=true. Current quote-request eligibility applies. Advocate attempts a notification through the business's configured lead routing channel (SMS/email); provider acceptance is not proof the business read it. Quote and callback requests share contact, address and business limits. An address or business ceiling saves the request without sending a notification. A failed or pending result is not proof of delivery; check the same request. Reusing the same idempotency_key and details returns the original outcome without another send or count. Changed details are refused. If the result includes customer_notice, show it to the customer word for word.

consent.description: True only after the customer explicitly agrees to send these contact details and this callback request to the named business

idempotency_key.description: Reuse with the same request details to check or retry without another send

reason.description: Why the user wants the callback

name: request_callback

acknowledgment.description: Customer-facing sentence to relay; null only on a replay caught while the original send is still in flight

customer_notice.description: A sentence for the customer. When present, show it to them word for word.

form_url.description: Present with reason 'form_routing_configured': the business's own contact form for the user to complete, or null where the business chose form routing without supplying one

idempotent_replay.description: Present and true when this idempotency_key already had a request; nothing was re-sent

reason.description: Present for a known routing or provider outcome: 'form_routing_configured', 'no_recipient_configured', 'sms_consent_missing', a shape-mismatch skip, a spend-cap denial, or a provider failure code

status.description: 'notified': the configured notification provider accepted the request; this does not prove the business read it. 'failed': routing was not available or the provider reported a failure — see reason. 'pending': a web-form business (see form_url), or a replay while the original send is still in flight or its delivery outcome is unconfirmed. Reuse the same request reference; do not create a duplicate.

status_token.description: Pass to get_request_status to read the business's answer. For this caller only.

title: Request Callback
